summary: POST /api/query has no max length — 10MB POST reaches embedder + LLM
description:
src/app/api/query/route.ts:33-44 trims the request body's `query` field but never bounds its length. A 10MB POST passes through to the embedder (Ollama nomic-embed-text) and then to the LLM (DeepSeek/Claude), burning compute on inputs that are not plausible user prompts.

Fix: hard-reject requests with `queryText.length > 4000` after trim, returning HTTP 400. No truncation — silently rewriting user input changes their intent and contradicts the no-fallback principle (per feedback memory).

Sizing: 4000 chars ≈ 1000 tokens. Comfortably accommodates a paragraph of pasted context plus a question. Embedder accepts 8192 tokens, DeepSeek 64K, Claude 200K — so 4000 chars is well within every downstream limit and the cap is purely an abuse/cost gate, not a technical one.

Status code: 400 (validation error) — not 413 (Payload Too Large), since the *request* isn't huge by HTTP standards; only the field value is over an app-domain limit.

Test: src/__tests__/api.test.ts new case: POST with query of 4001 chars returns 400, no embed/LLM/DB call.

Pairs with: 84ac8169 (frontend char counter, separate ticket).

resolution.test_function: returns 400 when query exceeds 4000-char hard cap
resolution.note: Hard reject at 4000 chars after trim, before any downstream work. Boundary test at exactly 4000 confirms inclusive limit. Frontend pair (84ac8169) still open.
